import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import PatternFill, Border, Side

# Load the workbook
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('/home/wushang/workspace/skills_evolve_v2/runs/spreadsheetbench_20260708_154932/nodes/n0000/burst_0000/exploit/step0/rollout/predictions/423-16/r0/workdir/input.xlsx')

# The yellow fill is stored as 'FFFFFF00' which is the ARGB format for #FFFF00
# Let's identify all yellow cells in column A of the 'Test' sheet
ws_test = wb['Test']

yellow_cells = []
for row in ws_test.iter_rows(min_col=1, max_col=1, max_row=ws_test.max_row):
    for cell in row:
        if cell.fill and cell.fill.start_color:
            rgb = cell.fill.start_color.rgb
            # Check for FFFF00 (yellow) - openpyxl stores it as FFFFFF00 (ARGB)
            if rgb in ('FFFF00', '00FFFF00', 'FFFFFF00'):
                if cell.value and str(cell.value).strip() != '':
                    print(f"Yellow cell at row {cell.row}: value='{cell.value}'")
                    yellow_cells.append((cell.row, str(cell.value).strip()))

print(f"\nFound {len(yellow_cells)} yellow non-blank cells in column A of Test sheet")

# Now transpose them to row 1 of the 'master' sheet
ws_master = wb['master']

# Clear the master sheet row 1 first
for col in range(1, ws_master.max_column + 1):
    ws_master.cell(row=1, column=col).value = None

# Fill the transposed values into row 1 of master sheet
for idx, (row_num, value) in enumerate(yellow_cells):
    col_idx = idx + 1  # Start from column A (column 1)
    cell = ws_master.cell(row=1, column=col_idx, value=value)
    
    # Apply yellow fill
    yellow_fill = PatternFill(start_color='FFFF00', end_color='FFFF00', fill_type='solid')
    cell.fill = yellow_fill
    
    # Apply borders (thin borders on all sides)
    thin_border = Border(
        left=Side(style='thin'),
        right=Side(style='thin'),
        top=Side(style='thin'),
        bottom=Side(style='thin')
    )
    cell.border = thin_border

print("\nTransposed values to master sheet row 1:")
for col in range(1, len(yellow_cells) + 1):
    cell = ws_master.cell(row=1, column=col)
    print(f"  Column {col}: value='{cell.value}', fill={cell.fill.start_color.rgb if cell.fill and cell.fill.start_color else 'None'}")

# Save the workbook
wb.save('/home/wushang/workspace/skills_evolve_v2/runs/spreadsheetbench_20260708_154932/nodes/n0000/burst_0000/exploit/step0/rollout/predictions/423-16/r0/workdir/output.xlsx')
